correctness.rationale: The lemma for 1 0^a 1 0^b 1 0^c rules out both possible later-1 starts of a border and is exact iff c>a. Reversal handles rotations beginning at the first zero of a gap; all remaining shifts have a one-letter border. A nontrivial power of a three-one word must be a cube with equal gaps, so distinctness follows. Orbit enumeration gives C_0,C_2,C_3 and expectation algebraically. checker.py independently checked 5456 zero-gap triples through m=30, full necklace histograms through m=16, and a primitive four-one obstruction; finite checks complement, not replace, the proof.

value.rationale: The border-correlation trace is a natural invariant from classic word-combinatorics literature. Classifying all boundary rotations for every three-marker circle yields a sharp composition-specific bound, the complete labeled-necklace distribution and an exact limiting sparse-content law. The structural lemma is stronger than a renamed scalar and has a sharp counterexample for four markers; the answer is an infinite classification, not a routine single numerical instance.
